scripts.build: npm --prefix ../importers run build && npm --prefix ../index run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix ../importers run build && npm --prefix ../index run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/units.test.mjs test/commands.test.mjs test/import.test.mjs test/process.test.mjs test/secrets.test.mjs
